title: Billing the Excess Mileage Charge on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — the excess mileage charge at lease end**

**Rule.** An excess mileage charge can be billed only while the lease status is returned or early terminated, and only once the inspection dispute period after the turn-in date has fully elapsed. It is billed once for the turn-in, as one end-of-term charge of the excess mileage kind whose miles over the allowance are the miles charged; when the miles charged are zero, no excess mileage charge is billed.

**Scope.** For the excess mileage charge of a turn-in, and only for that charge, the miles charged and the rate are figured under the excess mileage rule; every other end-of-term charge keeps the amount the end-of-term charges rule gives it.

**Invoice and due date.** An excess mileage charge billed under this rule is added to the lease-end account without a separate end-of-term invoice and falls due the end-of-term payment period, in calendar days, after the day it is billed, unless the balance is enrolled in a lease-end installment plan, whose installments then govern. An end-of-term invoice is mailed when any other end-of-term charge is billed.

**Business effect.** The charge appears on the lease's posting history as an excess mileage end-of-term charge carrying the miles charged, and the lease's end-of-term balance rises by the amount billed; the lessee sees the excess mileage charge on the lease-end account and a larger balance owed.

| Lease status | Inspection dispute period after the turn-in date fully elapsed | Miles charged | Excess mileage charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Returned or early terminated | yes | above zero | billed once |
| Returned or early terminated | yes | zero | not billed |
| Returned or early terminated | no | any | not yet billable |
| Any other status | — | — | not billable |

---

**Billing tool: `bill_excess_mileage_a1b25aac`**

*Capability.* Bills the excess mileage charge of a Kestrel closed-end lease whose vehicle has come back: one end-of-term charge entry of kind `excess_mileage_charge` on the lease's posting history, carrying the miles charged, raising the lease's end-of-term balance by the amount billed.

*How it is invoked.* This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_excess_mileage_a1b25aac` and then calls it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_contract_id` | the reference number of the lease record being billed, as the lease lookup returns it | identifier |
| `amount` | the excess mileage charge in USD | positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `miles_over` | the miles charged above the mileage allowance | non-negative integer count of miles |

*Return.* A receipt with `charge_id` (reference number of the new charge entry), `lease_contract_id`, `amount` (USD billed, 2 decimal places), `miles_over` (miles charged), `fee_type` (always `excess_mileage_charge`), `end_of_term_balance` (USD owed on the lease-end account including this charge, 2 decimal places) and `status` (`billed` when the charge is on the account).
